stem.text: When concentrated sulfuric acid is added to solid sodium chloride, $\text{HCl}$ is formed but **not** $\text{Cl}_2$.
When concentrated sulfuric acid is added to solid sodium iodide, $\text{I}_2$ is formed.

A.text: Sulfuric acid is an oxidising agent and chloride ions are more easily oxidised than iodide ions.

B.text: Sulfuric acid is an oxidising agent and iodide ions are more easily oxidised than chloride ions.

C.text: Sulfuric acid is a reducing agent and chloride ions are more easily reduced than iodide ions.

D.text: Sulfuric acid is a reducing agent and iodide ions are more easily reduced than chloride ions.
